# Third-party code

Scorers, Blender helpers, and prompts originate from gaoypeng/3dcodebench at
`42c7780ed3fcbd466f17f058f62e7996233777f7` (Apache-2.0).
Uni3D point_encoder.py originates from BAAI-Vision/Uni3D at
`64e03c3c42c196e8cb5ed03857810af9fc9ac39c` (MIT, copyright 2023 BAAI-Vision).
Original licenses are included here. Original file hashes are in provenance.json.
Gym changes package paths, defaults, and formatting; scoring algorithms are preserved.
Dataset and learned model weights are downloaded separately under their original licenses.
